research_question: Can generic comment/paragraph scoring and repository-specific training augmentation improve external recall while preserving benign document-level FPR?

candidates.weights: same v1 architecture refit using original training split plus new training-only examples

segmentation_policy.warning: Multiple blocks change score distribution and FPR; calibrate each candidate at document level.

augmentation.split_rule: Connected groups sharing repository/source family, attack template family, derivation parent, or near duplicate text must stay in one split.
augmentation.synthetic_examples: Explicitly tag authoring/generation method; never describe generated cases as independently observed real attacks.
augmentation.maintainer_30_policy: Development diagnostics only; all 30 confirmed benign by single user using Chinese translations, with extra context for sample 12; not an independent confirmation set.
augmentation.candidate_batch1_status: 24 AI-authored synthetic examples reviewed by project user; used only as training augmentation in exploratory development.
augmentation.candidate_batch2_status: 12 AI-authored examples reviewed by project user; sample 8 disagreement resolved as benign. Shared families grouped with batch1.

validation.threshold_policy: For each candidate maximize recall subject to document-level confirmed-benign FPR <= 0.05; ties prefer lower FPR then higher threshold.
validation.candidate_selection: Prefer higher recall at the constraint; also report per-source FPR and per-family recall, retaining all four candidates in the comparison.
validation.minimum_counts: To be fixed from source availability before fitting; always report exact counts and uncertainty, no significance claim from small samples.

training_ready_scope: False applies to the full independent-confirmation protocol, not the completed separate development experiment.
remaining_dependencies: Broaden repository-specific attack and benign family coverage before a new experiment
Add and evaluate explicit task scope separately from tool whitelist if authorization work is continued
